gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-huninn: Capture It packs its letters nearly shut, with hardly a gap anywhere. Huninn, the sans-serif underneath, opens everything back up, its lowercase rising close to cap height and its crossbars as fat as the stems.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-karla: Stocky, wide-mouthed lowercase makes the body text feel friendly next to the nearly sealed letters of Capture It. Karla would carry a full page without tiring, its gaping c and wide band keeping each line approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-kedebideri: Capture It crowds its letters shut, urban and loud. Kedebideri, rounded and open with its skyward x-height line, gives the page some room to breathe beneath that dense heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-khula: Khula holds its curves open with a full, squat midsection like a brush-pen belly, built for steady reading. And Capture It is at its best when loud, with wire-thick strokes throughout and letters shut nearly tight.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-krub: Capture It shuts its letters almost completely, a dense, urban block. Krub, with its pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves left unfinished, supplies the pairing's best quality: it opens what the heading closes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-kufam: Capture It crams its letters nearly shut, urban and loud. Kufam, drawn like a neon sign tube with generously open e curves, would read smoothly over a full page, its bodies dominating while ascenders barely show.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-lexend: Approachable is Lexend's whole manner, with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, against the nearly sealed letters of Capture It. Paragraphs would move along easily, with strokes that hold steady.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-liter: Capture It does its best work in dense, nearly sealed letters that feel urban and commanding. While Liter, with zero stroke contrast, does its best with wide mouths on round forms and strong vertical presence.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-mada: Curves that refuse to close and a lofty midzone make the body text feel friendly and modern. Mada gives the nearly sealed letters of Capture It a counterweight that breathes, display above and open text below.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-matangi: Matangi draws strokes like pressed twine, rounded and open with a hefty lowercase, beneath the nearly sealed letters of Capture It. Loud, urban display up top, soft and sturdy text below.
